pages.title: Cabinet card
pages.reaction: Gilbert's patter songs are rhythm machines, so I'd love to loop one. This page is about photo cards, not songs, which is a funny mismatch. Still, the card sizes are a nice rhythm of their own: 4.5 by 6.5, then 5.25 by 8.5. Wasn't much here for a comic opera tinkerer, though.
